import java.io.File;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.net.URL;
import java.net.URLClassLoader;

/**
 * Generated by AeroRunTekDeobfuscator
 *
 * Launches the RS 508 client from the original JAR.
 * The client's own main() method handles JFrame creation and boot args.
 *
 * Default boot args: 1 live live software members english game0
 */
public class Main {

    private static final String CLIENT_JAR = "{JAR_PATH}";

    private static final String[] DEFAULT_ARGS = {
        "1", "live", "live", "software", "members", "english", "game0"
    };

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        File jar = new File(CLIENT_JAR);
        if (!jar.exists()) {
            System.err.println("[Main] Client JAR not found: " + jar.getAbsolutePath());
            System.exit(1);
        }

        // Load the client JAR
        URLClassLoader loader = new URLClassLoader(
                new URL[]{ jar.toURI().toURL() },
                Main.class.getClassLoader()
        );

        // Set as context classloader so the client can load its own classes
        Thread.currentThread().setContextClassLoader(loader);

        // Load and invoke client.main(String[] args)
        Class<?> clientClass = loader.loadClass("client");
        Method mainMethod = clientClass.getMethod("main", String[].class);

        // Use provided args or defaults
        String[] bootArgs = (args != null && args.length >= 7) ? args : DEFAULT_ARGS;
        System.out.println("[Main] Launching RS 508 client...");
        mainMethod.invoke(null, (Object) bootArgs);
    }
}
